q1.explanationZh: 第四段说他能发短信、发邮件、网上买东西、编辑文件，没有提到看电影和开发应用，所以是①和④。

evidence.quote: I can text and email friends and family, listen to my favourite songs online, shop on Amazon, and edit documents.

q2.explanationZh: 最后一段说很多应用和网站没有为屏幕阅读器设计好，这就是他的抱怨。

evidence.quote: Many apps and websites are not designed to work well with screen readers.

q3.explanationZh: 文章先写他视力很差的困难，再写屏幕阅读器怎样改变了他的生活，所以目的是展示这种改变。

evidence.quote: That was a game-changer for people like me.
